title: Exploiting Decompression Latency for Covert Channels in Inter-Line-Compressed LLCs
summary: The recently proposed XOR cache is an inter-line-compressed last-level cache (LLC) that leverages the data-inclusion relationship between the private caches and the LLC, compressing two cache lines into one by XORing them. The architecture relies on the cache coherence protocol for data decompression. In this paper, we demonstrate that this mechanism - specifically the latency asymmetry between a cache hit on an uncompressed vs. compressed line - introduces microarchitectural vulnerabilities. Ba
